annotations.title: Staking v2 (multi-reward): status, rates, APR, position

description: BlazarMultiRewardStaking (staking v2: stake BZB, earn up to 5 reward tokens, no lock). NOT DEPLOYED YET: returns NOT_DEPLOYED until it has an address. When live, one call returns status/alerts first, minStake, totalStaked, every reward token with per-second rate, next-24h and next-7d emission from the run curves, APR (token-denominated or Chainlink USD when available), run schedule, and optionally one account's stake, share and claimable rewards. Use before blazar_build_staking_v2. Polygon only (chain 137).

account.description: Optional: include this address's stake, pool share and claimable rewards.
